# Lemon.io MCP

**MCP server from Lemon.io (repository install)** — the established developer marketplace brings hiring into the conversation: describe what you need and the agent drafts job descriptions, prepares technical interviews by stack and seniority, and requests dedicated senior developers for the project — without leaving the chat. `github.com/lemon-io/lemon-io-mcp`.

```
Server type: Repository install (no standard config block published)
Auth: not published on the listing
Repo: https://github.com/lemon-io/lemon-io-mcp
Tools: not extracted from the listing — capability surface is JD drafting, interview prep, developer requests (live tool list served from the endpoint)
Pricing: marketplace model (Lemon.io engagement fees; not published in the listing)
Category: Hiring
Built by: Lemon.io
```

## Why This Matters for Operators

Hiring a senior developer has three slow parts — writing the JD, screening candidates, and running a real technical interview. Lemon.io's MCP attacks the parts that are pure craft: a professional, role-specific job description from requirements, and curated technical-interview questions by stack and seniority.

**The differentiator is the marketplace behind the tools**: Lemon.io is an established vetted-developer marketplace, so "request a senior React developer for a fintech project" is not a search query — it is an engagement flow with real, pre-vetted engineers on the other end. The MCP makes the top of the hiring funnel a conversation instead of a form.

Follow the repository README (`github.com/lemon-io/lemon-io-mcp`) to install the server and add its MCP configuration to your client.

## Configuration

The listing publishes no parseable config block; use the README's configuration in your MCP client once the repository is installed.

## Business Relevance

- **Founders hiring first engineers** get a credible JD without a recruiter and interview questions matched to stack.
- **Engineering managers** get a drafting loop in chat — "write a JD for a full-stack engineer with Node.js and AWS".
- **Agencies staffing client projects** get a channel to vetted senior developers on demand.
- **Non-technical operators** get interview prep that makes a technical screen survivable.

## Integration with CorpusIQ

Lemon.io pairs with CorpusIQ's pipeline tooling for the hiring workflow. The HubSpot CRM connector holds the candidate and role records while Lemon.io generates the JD and interview kit, and the JobYap MCP already in the catalog supplies market-rate and hiring-market context so the agent can sanity-check a role spec against real postings before engaging the marketplace. It also complements the inbound lead pipeline — a founder request for developer help can flow from the same lead tracker the sales motion uses.

## Limitations

- Brand new — no track record yet; listing appeared August 17, 2026.
- No published tool list or config block — verify against the live endpoint after install.
- Developer engagement runs through Lemon.io's marketplace and fees — it is a staffing channel, not a free job board.
- Interview prep is generic per stack; not tuned to your specific codebase.
- README-only documentation — no OAuth or auth detail published on the listing.
